# x402-otp-relay

> The 'code sent to your email' step, solved for agents: paid relay mailboxes, retrieved OTP codes returned in-response

x402-otp-relay is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-otp-relay/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
